notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.

Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression, cardValue and bias sizes were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan-g2.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.

goFirst false: strategy-concepts §10 [S17], 'go second with counter-heavy and late-game decks'; the guide's Leader defends rather than attacks and wants DON!! active on their turn. The guide gives no seat advice of its own.
weights.don 1.2: the guide's engine is a dense package of cards that set DON!! active [SH-RGL]; DON!! next turn counts a little more.
counterAggression 1.05 and faceBias 0.95/1.0/1.05: 'a Straw Hat Crew midrange deck whose leader defends rather than attacks' [SH-RGL]; inference.
cardValue: the restand cards (Sanji, Usopp, Nami OP14-031) and the closers named in 'Defining cards'.

mulligan: the guide's keepable hand (inference): a T1 searcher, a restand piece and a couple of +1000/+2000 Counter cards; going second one piece short is fine (Usopp and Sanji without a searcher); going first the searcher is required ('be stricter' [SH-MUL]).
seed 4 (Charlestone) has no bias of its own if search alone holds it; see the test file for which seeds pass without biases.
